confirm.title: Add {name}
confirm.description: Add this tvbox to Home Assistant as a media player. It is controlled over the MQTT broker you already use - no address or password is needed.

user.title: Add a tvbox
user.description: A box announces itself on the broker, so this is only needed if the announcement did not arrive. The device id is on the box under Settings, Network, MQTT.

error.invalid_device_id: Letters, digits, underscore and hyphen only - the id is an MQTT topic segment.

abort.already_configured: This box is already set up.
abort.invalid_discovery_info: That MQTT message did not come from a tvbox.
